metadata.description: Plugins that connect Cursor to a demarkus server.

plugins.name: demarkus-memory
plugins.description: Zero-config local memory for Cursor. Spawns a local demarkus-server and wires MCP tools for fetch/publish/append/graph/lookup over your own versioned markdown store, and self-documents sessions to it. /memory-join adds remote memories with per-project binding and a destination gate; /promote lifts ready notes to a joined knowledge system.
